project.title: Launch of Connected Industrial Monitoring Module
project.objective: Design, build, and pilot a connected monitoring module for industrial equipment that integrates hardware and software to reduce unplanned downtime for key customers.
deliverables: Functional hardware design and production-ready prototype of monitoring module
Embedded electronics and wiring schematics with safety and compliance documentation
Edge software and backend integration spec for data collection and alerts
Pilot installation and test report at two customer production lines
Sales and application engineering deployment playbook
Costed manufacturing and rollout plan with ROI assumptions
constraints: Pilot-ready prototype must be available within 30 days
Hardware must comply with relevant industrial electrical safety standards
Solution must integrate with existing customer PLC/SCADA interfaces
Target bill of materials must not exceed agreed cost ceiling
Limited access to customer sites for testing and installation windows

risks.risk: Hardware prototype fails environmental or electrical safety tests late in the schedule.
risks.mitigation: Run early bench tests against safety checklist and schedule an interim design review before finalizing PCB and enclosure.

risks.risk: Software integration with customer systems takes longer than expected.
risks.mitigation: Define minimal viable data interface upfront and validate with customer IT using a sandbox before full integration.

risks.risk: Manufacturing cost exceeds target, making the module commercially unattractive.
risks.mitigation: Production engineer and design engineer run early cost estimation and identify alternative components and design-to-cost options.

risks.risk: Pilot customers are not available for on-site tests within the timebox.
risks.mitigation: Secure written pilot commitments and backup pilot sites, and prepare remote test procedures where possible.

risks.risk: Cross-functional misalignment on feature scope leads to rework.
risks.mitigation: Agree on a frozen MVP feature list and change control process documented and shared with all stakeholders.

themes.why_relevant: Tight coordination is needed so electronics, firmware, and data interfaces align with real-world constraints.
The module operates in industrial environments and must meet electrical and safety standards to be deployable.
Design choices must support scalable production and keep BOM within target to ensure commercial viability.
Pilot sites validate technical fit, usability, and value; feedback will drive iteration and rollout decisions.
Collected data must be accurate, secure, and reliably transmitted for monitoring and alerting to be trusted.
Sales and application teams need clear playbooks and technical collateral to position and deploy the module.

backlog.task: Define MVP feature set and system requirements for the monitoring module
definition_of_done: Requirements document approved by production engineer, design engineer, electrical engineer, and computer scientist
MVP feature list frozen with clear in-scope and out-of-scope items
Assumptions and open questions logged and assigned

backlog.task: Create mechanical and enclosure design for industrial monitoring module
definition_of_done: 3D CAD models and technical drawings completed and reviewed
Enclosure meets IP and mounting requirements defined in requirements
Design signed off by electrical engineer and production engineer for fit and manufacturability

backlog.task: Develop electrical schematics and wiring plans for sensors and power
definition_of_done: Complete set of schematics and wiring diagrams produced
Compliance and safety checklist completed with no critical gaps
Schematics reviewed with design engineer and application engineer

backlog.task: Design data architecture and edge-to-cloud communication protocol
definition_of_done: Architecture diagram and interface specification documented
Data model and API endpoints defined and shared
Latency, security, and reliability requirements captured and agreed

backlog.task: Implement edge software for data acquisition and local buffering
definition_of_done: Edge software prototype runs on target hardware or dev board
Supports configured sensors and basic buffering logic
Passes initial functional tests defined in test plan

backlog.task: Plan and validate manufacturability and assembly process
definition_of_done: Preliminary process flow and work instructions drafted
Cycle time and capacity estimates documented
Pilot build plan with required tooling and resources approved

backlog.task: Run integrated prototype tests in lab environment
definition_of_done: Test plan executed covering functional, environmental, and safety checks
Issues logged with owners and priorities
Go/no-go recommendation for customer pilot documented

backlog.task: Estimate BOM cost and identify cost optimization options
definition_of_done: BOM with supplier quotes compiled
Total cost compared against target and gaps highlighted
List of alternative components or design changes proposed

backlog.task: Prepare sales and deployment playbook for pilot customers
definition_of_done: Playbook covers value proposition, technical overview, and deployment steps
Includes standard configuration templates and FAQs
Reviewed by sales engineer and updated based on feedback

backlog.task: Define test procedures and acceptance criteria for customer pilots
definition_of_done: Pilot test procedures documented with clear steps and metrics
Acceptance criteria aligned with MVP requirements
Approved by application engineer and production engineer

backlog.task: Coordinate on-site pilot installation and data validation
definition_of_done: Pilot installation schedule agreed with customer
Module installed and connected to customer systems
Initial data validated and sample reports shared with stakeholders

backlog.task: Consolidate pilot learnings and recommend next iteration scope
definition_of_done: Feedback from all stakeholders and customers summarized
Key technical and commercial findings documented
Proposal for next iteration scope and rollout plan shared

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on MVP scope and system requirements across all roles.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and requesting input on the draft MVP requirements.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the MVP feature list and freeze the initial scope documented in A1.
Agree on the minimal data set and interfaces to be supported in the first pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Converge on hardware, enclosure, and electrical design choices.
threads_plan.trigger: Design engineer shares first pass of mechanical design and requests feedback from electrical and production.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the enclosure concept and confirm mounting and IP requirements.
Confirm that electrical schematics meet safety checklist A2 and are ready for prototype build.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and validate the data architecture and edge software plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Computer scientist posts the initial data architecture and API spec for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the data architecture and communication protocol described in A4.
Agree on the minimal edge software capabilities to implement in T5 for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and coordinate lab tests and customer pilot installation.
threads_plan.trigger: Application engineer proposes a timeline for lab integration tests and pilot deployment.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock the lab test plan and acceptance criteria for moving to customer pilot.
Confirm pilot customer sites, installation dates, and responsibilities using A5.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and agree on next-iteration and rollout plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Production engineer shares the draft pilot feedback report and asks for comments.

channel_rituals: Daily async standup where each role posts yesterday-today-blockers in one thread.
Twice-weekly design and integration checkpoint to review open decisions and risks.
Weekly pilot readiness review summarizing test status and open issues against A7.
Post-pilot retrospective to capture learnings and update A8 and future practices.
